outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL OCCUR LATER TODAY THROUGH EARLY FRIDAY OVER THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS. MORE ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAY OCCUR MAINLY THIS AFTERNOON OVER THE NORTHERN ROCKIES...AND FROM THE OZARKS INTO PARTS OF THE SOUTHEAST.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE NRN PLNS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE CNTRL PLNS... ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE ERN CAROLINAS... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE NRN RCKYS/NRN PLNS S/SE THROUGH THE CNTRL PLNS/OZARKS TO THE CAROLINA CST...

sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: SRN U.S. RIDGE WILL FURTHER AMPLIFY ACROSS THE CNTRL PLNS THIS PERIOD...WHILE BROAD CYCLONIC FLOW PERSISTS OVER THE PAC NW...THE NRN RCKYS...AND NERN STATES. SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW OVER CNTRL MT SHOULD CONTINUE NE INTO SE SK/WRN ND THIS EVE...BEFORE TURNING ENE INTO WRN ONT EARLY FRI. ELSEWHERE...A SERIES OF DISTURBANCES WILL TRACK ESE FROM ERN PORTIONS OF THE PLNS AND THE OZARKS TO THE SRN APPALACHIANS/CAROLINAS. IN THE WEST...SEVERAL WEAK IMPULSES WILL ACCOMPANY LINGERING BAND OF ENHANCED SW FLOW ACROSS THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION. AT THE SFC...LOW NOW OVER THE MT-ND BORDER...WITH AN ASSOCIATED LEE TROUGH EXTENDING S INTO THE CNTRL HIGH PLNS...SHOULD REDEVELOP ESE INTO N CNTRL SD BY THIS EVE...AND CONTINUE NE INTO NW MN EARLY FRI. COLD FRONT TRAILING SW FROM THE LOW WILL OVERTAKE NRN PART OF LEE TROUGH AND ADVANCE SE INTO THE SD BADLANDS BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. FARTHER SE...DIFFUSE STNRY FRONT WILL PERSIST FROM THE OZARKS ESE THROUGH THE TN VLY TO THE CAROLINAS. A WEAK WAVE ALONG THIS BOUNDARY WILL TRACK SLOWLY E OR ESE ALONG THE SC-NC BORDER THROUGH EARLY TNGT.

sections.title: NRN PLNS LATER TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: LOW-LVL MOISTURE WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD N INTO THE DAKOTAS TODAY...ON W SIDE OF RETREATING MIDWEST SFC RIDGE. COUPLED WITH LOCAL EVAPOTRANSPIRATION...EXPECT PW TO BE AOA 1.50 BY THIS EVE ACROSS ERN SD AND CNTRL ND...WITH VALUES INCREASING TO AOA 1.75 OVER THE RED RVR VLY/WRN MN EARLY FRI. COUPLED WITH STRONG SFC HEATING AND RELATIVELY STEEP MID-LVL LAPSE RATES...THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR STRONG UPDRAFTS BY LATE THIS AFTN OVER MUCH OF THE DAKOTAS. COMBINATION OF INCREASING BUOYANCY...AND MODEST LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH MT UPR TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED LOBE OF VORTICITY EXTENDING SE TOWARD THE BLACK HILLS...SHOULD SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF NUMEROUS TSTMS BY MID TO LATE AFTN ALONG COLD FRONT IN WRN ND AND...A BIT LATER...SWD ALONG LEE TROUGH. ALTHOUGH SWLY DEEP SHEAR INITIALLY WILL BE COMPARATIVELY MODEST...SHEAR WILL INCREASE TO AROUND 50 KT BY EARLY TNGT AS THE MT SYSTEM CONTINUES ENEWD. THUS...POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR CLUSTERS OF SUSTAINED/ORGANIZED STORMS...INCLUDING EMBEDDED/SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL...DMGG WIND...AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO OR TWO. THE STORMS LIKELY WILL ORGANIZE INTO ONE OR TWO EWD-MOVING COMPLEXES TNGT AS SWLY LLJ ST

sections.title: CNTRL PLNS LT AFTN/EVE
sections.text: A SEPARATE AREA OF STRONG TO SVR LATE AFTN/EVE STORMS MAY ARISE OVER S CNTRL SD AND NRN/WRN NEB...WHERE CONVERGENCE SHOULD BE MAXIMIZED ALONG EWD-MOVING SEGMENT OF LEE TROUGH/DRY LINE. WITH 30+ KT WNWLY FLOW OVERSPREADING REGION IN ASSOCIATION WITH SRN SIDE OF MT TROUGH...AND WITH ASCENT ALSO POSSIBLY BOOSTED BY AN APPARENT IMPULSE NOW IN WY /PER WV/...SETUP COULD YIELD A FEW STORMS WITH BOTH DMGG WIND AND HAIL. THESE STORMS MAY PERSIST AS A SMALL...SE-MOVING CLUSTER THROUGH LATE TNGT.

sections.title: ERN CAROLINAS AFTN
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF STRONG STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO ORGANIZE INVOF AFOREMENTIONED FRONTAL WAVE OVER ERN NC...WITH DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLY EXTENDING SWWD INTO NE SC LATER TODAY. COMBINATION OF VERY MOIST AIR /PW AOA 2.25 INCHES/ AND MODEST BUT BACKED LOW-LVL FLOW NEAR FRONT MAY YIELD A TORNADO OR TWO...IN ADDITION TO LOCALLY DMGG GUSTS AND POSSIBLY ISOLD HAIL BEFORE THE ACTIVITY WEAKENS/CONTINUES OFFSHORE THIS EVE.

sections.title: OZARKS TO SRN APPALACHIANS AFTN
sections.text: WDLY SCTD CLUSTERS OF STRONG TO PERHAPS BRIEFLY SVR STORMS WITH LOCALLY DMGG WIND SHOULD ONCE AGAIN OCCUR ALONG AND IMMEDIATELY S OF STALLED FRONT. AREAS OF MOST CONCENTRATED DEVELOPMENT WILL AGAIN BE MODULATED BY PASSING UPR IMPULSES...ONE OF WHICH NOW APPEARS TO BE OVER SW MO ...WITH ANOTHER NOW APPROACHING MIDDLE TN.

sections.title: NRN RCKYS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: SCTD MAINLY HIGH-BASED STORMS WITH A RISK FOR ISOLD...LOCALLY DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL FORM OVER PARTS OF THE NRN RCKYS/INTERMOUNTAIN REGION THIS AFTN...WHERE 30+ KT UNIDIRECTIONAL CLOUD-LAYER SW FLOW WILL PREVAIL AMIDST 0.75 INCH PW WITH DEEPLY-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYERS. ..CORFIDI/PETERS.. 07/23/2015

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL OCCUR LATER TODAY THROUGH EARLY FRIDAY OVER THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS. MORE ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAY OCCUR MAINLY THIS AFTERNOON OVER THE NORTHERN ROCKIES...AND WILL CONTINUE FROM THE OZARKS INTO PARTS OF THE SOUTHEAST.

sections.title: DISCUSSION
sections.text: ONLY A FEW MINOR CHANGES TO THE OUTLOOK APPEAR NECESSARY ATTM...WITH OVERALL FORECAST REASONING AND AREAS ON TRACK. HAVE TRIMMED THE ERN U.S. SLIGHT RISK A BIT ON THE NRN FRINGE -- I.E. E CENTRAL NC -- WITH MORE STABLE AIR INDICATED N OF A FAIRLY WELL-DEFINED W-E OUTFLOW OVER SERN NC. IN ADDITION...MINOR SWD EXPANSION OF THE CENTRAL U.S. SLIGHT RISK AREA IS ALSO BEING IMPLEMENTED...AS ISOLATED STORMS HAVE BEGUN DEVELOPING AS FAR S AS NERN CO THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTIVE OF MARGINAL HAIL/WIND GUSTS. ..GOSS.. 07/23/2015 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 0112 PM CDT THU JUL 23 2015/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INCREASING THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE THROUGH MID TO LATE AFTERNOON...ACCOMPANIED BY THE RISK FOR GUSTY WINDS...IN ADDITION TO FREQUENT CLOUD TO GROUND LIGHTNING AND HEAVY RAIN. BASED ON ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS...PEAK GUSTS SEEM LIKELY TO REMAIN MOSTLY BELOW SEVERE CRITERIA...BUT NEVERTHELESS COULD STILL BE STRONG/TURBULENT ENOUGH TO RESULT IN AT LEAST SPORADIC DAMAGE OF...AND RELATING TO...TREES/NEARBY POWER LINES. ALTHOUGH A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT AND/OR INTENSIFICATION ACROSS THE NORTH CAROLINA PIEDMONT INTO COASTAL PLAIN APPEARS TO BE FOCUSED ALONG AND SUPPORTED BY LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH A ZONE OF WEAK WARM ADVECTION. THIS IS OCCURRING IN THE PRESENCE OF SEASONABLY HIGH PRECIPITABLE WATER IN EXCESS OF 2 INCHES...AND SUFFICIENTLY STEEP LAPSE RATES TO SUPPORT MOST UNSTABLE/MIXED LAYER CAPE OF 1000-2000+ J/KG. THE LATEST RAPID REFRESH SUGGESTS THAT FORCING FOR THIS ZONE OF ASCENT MAY GRADUALLY WEAKEN THROUGH 16-17Z. HOWEVER...IT APPEARS POSSIBLE THAT THIS MAY MAINTAIN THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY LONG ENOUGH FOR SUBSTANTIVE SURFACE COLD POOLS TO DEVELOP...WHICH COULD CONTINUE TO SUPPORT NEW/STRENGTHENING CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY INTO/ THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...AS INHIBITION FOR MOIST DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER PARCELS ERODES. BENEATH 20-30 KT CYCLONIC WESTERLY 500 MB FLOW...IT ALSO APPEARS THAT SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR MAY EXIST TO ENHANCE CONVECTION AND CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION. THE GRADUAL EVOLUTION OF AN ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM MAY NOT BE OUT OF THE QUESTION...WHICH SHOULD TEND TO PROPAGATE SOUTHEAST AND SOUTH OF RALEIGH...TOWARD COASTAL AREAS...THROUGH 18-21Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE INITIATION OF VIGOROUS STORM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS POSSIBLE AS EARLY AS 20-21Z...WITH AN INCREASING RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL AND WIND GUSTS ACROSS THE REGION THEREAFTER. A SEVERE WEATHER WATCH PROBABLY WILL BE ISSUED AT SOME POINT...THOUGH TIMING REMAINS A BIT UNCERTAIN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTENING...AND HEATING/MIXING...CONTINUE NEAR A WEAK LOW WITHIN THE LEE SURFACE TROUGH...BENEATH A PLUME OF CAPPING WARM ELEVATED MIXED LAYER. ASSOCIATED DESTABILIZATION IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY CONDUCIVE TO VIGOROUS STORM DEVELOPMENT...AS FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH MID/UPPER TROUGHING BEGINS TO OVERSPREAD THE REGION. ACCOMPANIED BY A SOUTHEASTWARD ADVANCING SURFACE COLD FRONT...IT APPEARS THAT LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC COOLING MAY WEAKEN INHIBITION SUFFICIENTLY TO SUPPORT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT AS EARLY AS 20-21Z...TO THE NORTHWEST/WEST AND SOUTHWEST OF BISMARCK. DEEP LAYER SHEAR...AT LEAST ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT...MAY NOT BECOME MORE THAN WEAK TO MODEST IN STRENGTH...BUT THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT THE RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL IN INITIAL STORMS. THE RISK FOR STRONG...POTENTIALLY DAMAGING... WIND GUSTS IS EXPECTED TO THEN BECOME MORE PROMINENT THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON INTO EARLY EVENING...AS STORMS INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND CONSOLIDATE WHILE SPREADING EASTWARD INTO/THROUGH THE CENTRAL DAKOTAS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST/DEVELOP NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE REGION THROUGH 21-23Z. A WATCH LIKELY WILL BE ISSUED SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS HAVE INITIATED NEAR THE LEE SURFACE TROUGH... PROBABLY AS CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURES WERE REACHED...PERHAPS AIDED BY WEAK/SUBTLE FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH MID/UPPER TROUGHING PROGRESSING ACROSS THE NORTH CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS ACTUALLY CONFINED TO THE KANSAS/NEBRASKA BORDER AREA...WHERE SOUTHWESTERLY MID-LEVEL FLOW TRANSITIONS TO WESTERLY...AROUND THE PERIPHERY OF SUBTROPICAL RIDGING...WHICH APPEARS TO STILL BE BUILDING. THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF SUSTAINED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT REMAINS UNCLEAR DUE TO THE APPARENT PRESENCE OF MID-LEVEL HEIGHT RISES...BUT A FURTHER INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT SEEMS PROBABLE THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON ALONG/AHEAD OF THE LEE SURFACE TROUGH. THIS MAY GRADUALLY DEVELOP NORTH NORTHEASTWARD INTO PORTIONS OF THE SOUTHERN SOUTH DAKOTA DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. DESPITE THE GENERAL WEAK NATURE TO THE DEEP LAYER WESTERLY MEAN FLOW/SHEAR TO THE NORTH OF THE NEBRASKA/KANSAS BORDER AREA... THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES CHARACTERIZED BY A VERY WARM AND DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER...AND RELATIVELY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...ARE EXPECTED TO BE CONDUCIVE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF SEVERE HAIL AND WIND GUSTS IN STRONGEST STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE...MAINLY ACROSS SOUTHEAST NC AND POTENTIALLY INTO NORTHEAST SC. PORTIONS OF OR MUCH OF THE FIRST ROW OF COUNTIES ACROSS THE NORTHERN EXTENT OF WW 446 /HARNETT TO ONSLOW COUNTIES/ COULD BE REMOVED EARLY AS THE AIR MASS ACROSS THESE AREAS HAS STABILIZED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE GREATEST CONCENTRATION OF STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO BE FOCUSED IN VICINITY OF A SOUTHWARD-MOVING COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AS IT ADVANCES FROM SOUTHEAST NC INTO NORTHEAST SC LATE THIS AFTERNOON TO THE EARLY EVENING. AT 1935Z...THIS BOUNDARY EXTENDED FROM A CLUSTER OF STORMS THAT HAD MOVED EAST OF CARTERET COUNTY NC...AND WAS NOW LOCATED ABOUT 30 NM OFFSHORE...AND TRAILED SWWD TO NEAR ILM AND THEN WNWWD THROUGH BLADEN COUNTY NC TO HOKE AND ANSON COUNTIES NC. THE ENVIRONMENT NORTH OF THIS OUTFLOW BOUNDARY HAS STABILIZED IN THE WAKE OF CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING...WHILE THE AIR MASS WITH SOUTHWARD EXTENT REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE /MLCAPE AROUND 1500 J PER KG/. ALTHOUGH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR SUFFICIENT FOR STORM ORGANIZATION SHOULD PERSIST MAINLY ACROSS NC...STORM DEVELOPMENT REMAINS POSSIBLE INTO THE SC PORTION OF WW 446 AS 1/ THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MOVES SWD AND 2/ IN VICINITY OF A WESTWARD-MOVING SEA BREEZE WHERE LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS ENHANCED FOR SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS. ..PETERS.. 07/23/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT WILL CONTINUE OVER CNTRL ND AND PERHAPS EXTEND INTO N-CNTRL SD. LARGE HAIL AND SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SUBJECTIVE SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS A COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/COLD FRONT LOCATED FROM N-CNTRL ND SWWD INTO SWRN ND AND A DRYLINE EXTENDS SWD FROM A WEAK LOW 45 MI WNW BIS. A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER CHARACTERIZED BY SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S ARE CONTRIBUTING TO STRONG BUOYANCY ACROSS THE DAKOTAS IN THE WARM/MOIST SECTOR. VEERING FLOW IN THE 1-2 KM LAYER AND STRENGTHENING FLOW WITH HEIGHT IS SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS. THE ESEWD MOTION OF THE EFFECTIVE COLD FRONT WILL LIKELY REMAIN AHEAD OF THE STRONGER STORMS LOCATED OVER W-CNTRL ND AND WILL PROBABLY LIMIT LOW-LEVEL MESOCYCLONE POTENTIAL GIVEN THE UNDERCUTTING CHARACTER OF THE FRONT. LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE HAZARDS THIS EVENING AS THE ACTIVITY MOVES EWD INTO CNTRL ND. ..SMITH.. 07/23/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SVR TSTMS CONTINUES IN WW 447.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTMS CONTINUE ON THE WARM/MOIST SIDE /EAST TO SOUTH/ OF A MIXING BOUNDARY/LEE TROUGH ANALYZED FROM N-CNTRL NEB/S-CNTRL SD TO ERN CO. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD EWD/SEWD DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...AND REMAIN CAPABLE OF SVR WIND/HAIL IN A STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WITH AROUND 40 KT OF DEEP SHEAR SAMPLED BY THE LNX VWP. MOSAIC RADAR AND VIS SATELLITE LOOPS SUGGEST THAT THE BOUNDARY IS SLOWLY ADVANCING NWD ACROSS PARTS OF NEB/SD...POTENTIALLY REMAINING AN INITIATING BOUNDARY FOR CONVECTION IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS AS RICHER BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE OVERSPREADS STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. WITH WEAK LARGE-SCALE ASCENT OVER THE AREA...AND CONVECTION PRIMARILY BEING DRIVEN BY DIURNAL HEATING...A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND IS FORECAST TO OCCUR AROUND/AFTER DUSK AS INHIBITION SLOWLY GROWS NOCTURNALLY. ..COHEN.. 07/23/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SUPERCELL IN MINER COUNTY WILL POSE THE RISK FOR ALL SVR HAZARDS AS IT TRACKS EWD/ESEWD IN THE SHORT-TERM. SUCH POTENTIAL WILL REMAIN TOO ISOLATED AND SHORT-DURATION FOR WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SUPERCELL IS MOVING EWD/ESEWD ACROSS MINER COUNTY IN A STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. HIGH THETA-E IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER/MIDDLE 70S HAS ALLOWED MLCINH TO BE SLOW TO INCREASE...WHILE THE FSD VWP HAS INDICATED A STRONG INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL SRH DURING THE PAST FEW HOURS IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY-LAYER WIND MAX. THE SUPERCELL CONTINUES TO SUPPORT POTENTIAL FOR ALL SEVERE HAZARDS /WIND...HAIL...AND TORNADO/...AND RADAR DATA SUGGEST MODERATE-STRONG LOW-LEVEL ROTATION ASSOCIATED WITH THIS STORM. THIS STORM WILL LIKELY POSE SIMILAR RISKS IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO BEFORE IT ADVANCES INTO COOLER AIR WITH RELATED INHIBITION ENHANCED BY DIABATIC SFC COOLING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT IS TRANSITIONING TO AN ISOLD SEVERE WIND GUST RISK ACROSS THE RED RIVER VALLEY THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SUBJECTIVE SURFACE MESOANALYSIS SHOWS A MOISTURE RESERVOIR OVER THE ERN DAKOTAS WITH THE ERN BOUND OF THE RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE DELINEATED BY A WARM FRONTAL ZONE NEAR THE MN/DAKOTAS BORDER. RECENT RADAR IMAGERY HAS SHOWN A CONSOLIDATION AND UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A SQUALL LINE ACROSS E-CNTRL ND. THIS ACTIVITY WILL PROGRESS EWD AND POSE PRIMARILY A STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT AS IT CROSSES THE RED RIVER /FROM NORTH TO SOUTH/ IN THE 04-06Z PERIOD. DESPITE THE STRENGTHENING OF THE LLJ OVER THE ERN DAKOTAS THIS EVENING /REFERENCE KABR AND KFSD VAD DATA/...THE RICH MOISTURE WILL LIKELY BE SLOW TO INFILTRATE THE AREAS OVER WRN MN. THIS SHOULD RESULT IN LESS BUOYANCY AND CORRESPONDING LOWER POTENTIAL FOR AN ORGANIZED SEVERE THREAT LATER TONIGHT AS STORMS MOVE INTO CNTRL AND N-CNTRL MN LATER TONIGHT. WHILE AN ISOLD LARGE HAIL/WIND RISK MAY ACCOMPANY STORMS DEVELOPING IN THE WARM SECTOR OVER NERN SD...CURRENT THINKING IS THE COVERAGE/INTENSITY OF THESE STORMS WILL NOT NECESSITATE A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH DOWNSTREAM OVER W-CNTRL MN. NEEDLESS TO SAY...WILL MONITOR CONVECTIVE/ENVIRONMENT TRENDS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..SMITH.. 07/24/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE AS A LINE OF STORMS MOVES SEWD INTO THE FAR SERN PART OF WW 448 OVER THE NEXT HOUR. THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE FOR A FEW MORE HOURS BUT SHOULD BECOME MORE ISOLATED WITH TIME. A LOCAL EXTENSION IN AREA AND TIME HAS BEEN DONE ACROSS PARTS OF WRN AND NCNTRL MN. ALTHOUGH WW ISSUANCE TO THE SE OF WW 448 APPEARS UNLIKELY...THE ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A 1004 MB LOW OVER NERN SD WITH A COLD FRONT LOCATED FROM CNTRL SD NEWD INTO ERN ND. AN AXIS OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS IN PLACE AHEAD OF THE FRONT WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS RANGE FROM THE MID 70S IN ERN SD TO THE MID TO UPPER 60S F ACROSS ERN ND AND WRN MN. AS A RESULT...MODERATE INSTABILITY IS ANALYZED ALONG THIS CORRIDOR WHICH IS FUELING THE CONVECTIVE CLUSTER NEAR THE ND-MN STATELINE AND ACROSS FAR NERN SD. THE ACTIVITY IS BEING SUPPORTED BY A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. AS THE THUNDERSTORMS MOVE ESEWD OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...THE CONVECTION WILL ENCOUNTER WEAKER INSTABILITY AND WEAKER DEEP-LAYER SHEAR TO THE SOUTHEAST OF WW 448. HOWEVER...THE STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO HAVE AN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT FOR A FEW MORE HOURS BEFORE BECOME MARGINAL DURING THE EARLY OVERNIGHT PERIOD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS MUCH OF CNTRL AND SRN MN IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MARGINAL OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE AS THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOP AND MOVE EWD ACROSS WRN AND CNTRL MN. WW ISSUANCE APPEARS UNLIKELY ACROSS THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN MCS IS ONGOING IN MUCH OF NW MN EXTENDING SEWD ACROSS SCNTRL MN. THIS ACTIVITY IS LOCATED TO THE EAST OF THE INSTABILITY AXIS BUT IS STILL IN A MOIST AIRMASS WITH SFC DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE LOWER TO MID 60S F. THIS COMBINED WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND 25 TO 35 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOULD BE ENOUGH FOR A FEW MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS WITH THE STRONGER THUNDERSTORMS. THE THREAT SHOULD GRADUALLY DECREASE AND NEW WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED ACROSS THE REGION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL AND A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS PARTS OF SE MN AND IA OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...WW ISSUANCE APPEARS UNLIKELY DUE TO THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN MCS IS ONGOING ACROSS MUCH OF ERN MN WITH SEVERAL STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ONGOING AT THE SRN END OF THE MCS IN SE MN AND FAR NRN IA. THIS ACTIVITY IS LOCATED ALONG THE ERN EDGE OF A CORRIDOR OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHERE MUCAPE IS ESTIMATED IN THE 1000 TO 1800 J/K RANGE BY MESOSCALE ANALYSIS. IN ADDITION...A 30 TO 45 KT LOW-LEVEL JET IS ANALYZED FROM NE NEB INTO SW MN WITH THE THUNDERSTORMS LOCATED ON THE ERN EDGE OF THE STRONGER FLOW. THIS COMBINED WITH LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A SUBTLE SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL LIKELY SUSTAIN THE THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS. THE CURRENT THINKING IS THAT THE STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE SEWD BUT SHOULD DEVELOP SWD AND REMAIN TIED TO THE ERN EDGE OF THE STRONGER INSTABILITY. THE WSR-88D VWP AT MINNEAPOLIS SHOWS SOME SPEED SHEAR IN THE MID-LEVELS WHICH COMBINED WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD BE ENOUGH FOR AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THREAT WITH THE STRONGER ELEVATED ROTATING STORMS. A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS CAN NOT BE RULED OUT AS WELL.
